Can Earl walk through every plot he owns (and no other plots) and return to his starting plot without backtracking? import openpyxl
from collections import defaultdict

def get_green_cells_grouped(file_path):
    wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(file_path)
    ws = wb.active
    rows = defaultdict(list)
    for row in ws.iter_rows():
        for cell in row:
            fill = cell.fill
            if fill and fill.fgColor and getattr(fill.fgColor, 'type', None) == 'rgb':
                color = fill.fgColor.rgb
                if color in ['FF00FF00', 'FF008000', 'FF00FF99']:
                    rows[cell.row].append(cell.column)
    # sort each row's columns ascending
    for r in rows:
        rows[r].sort()
    coords = []
    for r in sorted(rows.keys()):
        for c in rows[r]:
            coords.append((r, c))
    return rows, coords

rows, coords = get_green_cells_grouped('/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/5cfb274c-0207-4aa7-9575-6ac0bd95d9b2.xlsx')
